At the art collective's latest exhibition opening, Rachel slipped away unnoticed through the swinging doors into a quiet hall outside. A vision of red-hot rage simmered beneath her skin as she caught sight of a young couple posing for a photo – in front of one of her own installations.

Their grinning faces seemed to mock her. How could they do this to her? The art of those around her was not up for grabs, yet that's what kept happening. Each time it felt like a knife twisting deeper in her side.

Rachel willed herself to step back into the main reception area with a practiced smile – and pretend this moment wasn't hers alone.
